text:
The main ingredients in bread are flour, water, yeast, and salt.

Required equipment and materials for this hobby include:
- Large mixing bowl
- Measuring cups and spoons
- Kitchen scale (optional but recommended for accuracy)
- Dough scraper or bench knife
- Loaf pan or baking stone
- Oven
- Cooling rack

Sourcing options:
- Flour, yeast, and salt can be found at any local grocery store or supermarket.
- Specialized flours (such as whole wheat, rye, or bread flour) may be available at health food stores or specialty baking shops.
- Equipment can be purchased at kitchen supply stores, department stores, or online retailers.
